External data hardlink attacks are rejected by ONNX 1.21.0 checker hard_link_count validation, backported from https://github.com/onnx/onnx/commit/4755f8053928dce18a61db8fec71b69c74f786cb (GHSA-cmw6-hcpp-c6jp).
